definitions.explanation: ためらい (hesitation) plus the suffix 〜がち (tending to): describes speech or movement that keeps stopping and starting because the person is unsure. Most often used adverbially as ためらいがちに.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ためらいがちな⟦{口調|くちょう}→口調：11803_kuchou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}し→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: He began to speak in a hesitant tone.

examples.japanese: ためらいがち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{差|さ}し{出|だ}された→差し出す：04234_sashidasu⟧⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧、⟦{黙|だま}って→黙る：02287_damaru⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}った→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧。
examples.english: I silently accepted the letter that was held out to me so hesitantly.

notes:
Chiefly literary and descriptive; common in novels and narration, less so in everyday speech.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ためらいがち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to say hesitantly
- ためらいがちな⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧: a hesitant manner
- ためらいがち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{踏|ふ}み{出|だ}す→踏み出す：14283_fumidasu⟧: to step forward hesitantly

THE 〜がち SUFFIX:
Attaches to a noun or verb stem and means "tending to":
- ⟦{遠慮|えんりょ}がち→遠慮がち：18202_enryogachi⟧: reserved, holding back
- ⟦{忘|わす}れ→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧がち: apt to forget
- ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧がち: sickly, often ill
